components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default frosted-glass button: gloss gradient, blurred backdrop, inverts color on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { color: #222; max-width: 1000px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.65) 100%); border: 1.75px solid #222; border-radius: 15px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 1.5px 0 0 #fff inset; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), background 0.25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.18), 0 2px 0 0 #fff inset; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8f8ff 40%, #e0e0f8 100%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: invert(1); transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.10); transition: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #eaeaea 60%, #d5d5d5 100%); border-color: #bbb; color: #aaa; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Signature Button
components.description: The one gold-glow CTA reserved for the app's single most important action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-signature { border: 1.75px solid #f9b806; color: #f9b806; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rentoom-green-dark, #21573e) 0%, #24694a 50%, var(--rentoom-green-dark, #21573e) 100%); border-radius: 15px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; animation: ds-glow-pulse 6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-glow-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px 0 rgba(249,184,6,0.3), 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(33,87,62,0.18); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 32px 4px rgba(249,184,6,0.7), 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(33,87,62,0.18); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px 0 rgba(249,184,6,0.3), 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(33,87,62,0.18); } } .ds-btn-signature:active { transform: translateY(2px) scale(0.995); background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1c4a35 0%, #1f5a42 50%, #1c4a35 100%); animation: none; }

components.name: Manage Tile
components.description: Frosted-glass stay-management card with a category label, title, description, and price.
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: left; border-radius: 15px; padding: 18px; border: 2px solid transparent; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-tile--selected { transform: scale(1.02); border-color: rgba(33,87,62,0.45); box-shadow: 0 4px 18px 0 rgba(33,87,62,0.18); } .ds-tile-category { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); } .ds-tile-title-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-tile-title { font-weight: 700; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.9); } .ds-tile-chevron { opacity: 0.55; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); } .ds-tile-desc { font-size: 0.9rem; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-tile-price { margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 800; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }

components.name: Unlock Dial
components.description: Signature neumorphic circular control for the digital-lock unlock action; the only neumorphic element in the app.
components.html: <button class="ds-unlock-dial" aria-label="Unlock"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M6 10V7a6 6 0 1112 0v3M5 10h14v10H5z" stroke="#21573e" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-unlock-dial { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #f0f0f0; box-shadow: 10px 10px 20px #bebebe, -10px -10px 20px #ffffff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-unlock-dial:active { box-shadow: inset 10px 10px 20px #bebebe, inset -10px -10px 20px #ffffff; }

components.name: Chip Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped tag/badge, e.g. category labels and the unread-chat notification dot.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(33,87,62,0.1); color: var(--rentoom-green-dark, #21573e); font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Rounded toggle used for stay preferences and settings.
components.css: .ds-toggle { width: 46px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.18); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.18); position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle-thumb { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); transition: left 0.2s ease; } .ds-toggle[aria-checked="true"] .ds-toggle-thumb { left: 22px; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.35); }

narrative.overview: StayWell is the moment a guest arrives at a Rentoom apartment with no host in sight, and the app has to feel like a warm, competent concierge handing over a physical keycard — not a corporate self-service kiosk. The palette pulls from timber and forest (deep forest green, cabin brown, sage), every card and button is heavily rounded like a river stone or a rounded keycard corner, and the primary buttons are glossy and frosted — a gradient-and-glass surface with an inset white highlight that reads as something you press, not just tap. The one moment the whole app has been building to — unlocking the door — gets its own singular treatment: a neumorphic, pressed-metal dial unlike any other control in the app, and the one button style allowed to glow (a pulsing lantern-gold ring around a forest-green fill). Nothing in StayWell reaches for a big marketing hero moment: type stays compact (rarely above 1.3rem), density is high, and screens are built to be finished quickly by someone standing in a hallway with a suitcase, not lingered in. Warm materials, efficient task flow.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green + cabin brown + sage: an earthy, lodge palette, not a corporate blue/gray one.
Heavy, consistent rounding (12–18px on cards and buttons, pill/999px on badges, perfect circles on icon controls) — almost nothing in the app has a sharp corner.
Frosted glass surfaces: buttons and tiles use semi-transparent white gradients with backdrop-filter: blur(16px) over whatever sits behind them, not flat opaque fills.

Buttons feel physically pressable: a glossy top-lit gradient, an inset white highlight, and a genuinely unusual pressed state (color inversion + downward shift) rather than a simple opacity or darken.
Lantern-gold glow is reserved for exactly one thing: the signature 'open the door' action. It does not appear anywhere else.
Compact, utilitarian type scale — no large display type; the largest text in the app is a 1.3–1.6rem bold title.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Lantern-gold glow is reserved for the app's single signature call-to-action (the 'open apartment'/benefits moment). No other button, badge, or state may use the gold glow treatment — its rarity is what makes it register as 'the important one.'

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Every type distinction in StayWell is expressed through font-weight and font-size on Montserrat — never introduce a second font family for hierarchy.

rules.name: The Single Dial Rule
rules.body: Neumorphism is not a system-wide material; it belongs to exactly one control (the door unlock). Everything else uses soft ambient drop-shadow.

dos: Do keep lantern-gold glow exclusive to the single signature action per screen (The One Glow Rule).
Do use 15px as the default radius for new cards/buttons/tiles unless the element is a badge (999px) or icon control (50%).
Do use backdrop-filter: blur(16px) with a translucent white fill for new surface-level components, not solid opaque backgrounds.
Do preserve the invert-on-press button interaction as StayWell's signature press feedback.
Do keep the unlock dial's neumorphic shadow unique to that one control.
Do reference the existing --rentoom-green-dark, --rentoom-brown-dark, --rentoom-brown-light, --rentoom-green-sage custom properties instead of re-typing the hex.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface; all hierarchy comes from Montserrat weight/size.
Don't add large display/hero type — the largest text anywhere in the app is ~1.6rem; this is a task tool, not a marketing surface.
Don't apply the neumorphic shadow to any control other than the unlock dial.
Don't use flat, opaque white cards where the app's convention is translucent frosted glass.
Don't treat Confirm Green (#249223) and Forest Green (#21573e) as interchangeable — one means 'brand action,' the other means 'this choice is accepted.'
